Terms of use

Last updated: 28 October 2026

These terms apply when you use Backgammon League. By playing, you agree to them. Your statutory consumer rights are not affected.

Who provides the app

Backgammon League is provided by Panayiotis Panaretos, an individual developer based in Cyprus. Contact: panayiotiskpanaretos@gmail.com.

Who can play

You must be at least 18 years old to use Backgammon League. You are responsible for activity on your account and for keeping your sign-in details secure.

Fair play and conduct

Do not cheat. This includes using bots, analysis software or another person to choose your moves in online games, deliberately losing or colluding with another player, using several accounts to gain gold or rating, and exploiting bugs.

Do not use usernames or pictures that are offensive, hateful, sexual, impersonate someone else or infringe others' rights. We may change or remove them.

If we reasonably believe you have broken these rules, we may reverse affected results, gold or ratings, and suspend or close the account. Where appropriate we will tell you why, and you can contact us if you think we made a mistake.

Gold

Gold is virtual game currency. It has no monetary value and cannot be withdrawn, cashed out, sold, or transferred to another player or account. It is used for Casual and Ranked game entries inside the app.

Gold you buy is credited once to the account that was signed in when you bought it. Gold that has been used is not restored by Restore purchases. If a purchase is refunded or reversed, we may remove the gold it granted that has not yet been used.

We may correct gold balances that are wrong because of an error, fraud or a refund.

Ad-free subscription

The ad-free subscription removes ads from the app for the account that bought it. It costs EUR 4.99 per year, or the local price shown by the store before you pay, and renews automatically each year until you cancel.

Cancel through the store or payment provider you bought it from at least 24 hours before the renewal date. After cancelling, you keep ad-free access until the end of the period you have paid for. Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription.

Payments and refunds

Purchases are processed by Apple, Google Play or the web payment provider, and their terms also apply. Refund requests are handled through that store's process.

If a purchase does not appear after a network problem, use Restore / check purchases in the Shop, then contact us if it is still missing.

Online play and availability

Online game results, clocks, gold settlements and ratings are decided by our server's records. If a game is interrupted, the server's rules for reconnection, timeouts and resignation apply.

We work to keep the app available, but it may sometimes be unavailable for maintenance or because of problems outside our control. We may change, add or remove features. If we ever close the service, we will give reasonable notice in the app.

Liability

Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, including your rights as a consumer. Otherwise, we are not responsible for losses that were not reasonably foreseeable or that are caused by events outside our reasonable control.

Law and changes

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Cyprus. If you live in another country, you keep the protection of the mandatory consumer laws of that country and may bring claims in its courts.

We may update these terms. We will change the date above and, for significant changes, tell you in the app before they apply.
